meta: Write polite complaint letters that get results with AI: the angrier the letter, the easier it is to ignore.

muc.title: Too angry to work
muc.text: The angrier a complaint letter is, the easier it is to ignore. Letters that work are calm, clear about what happened and clear about what you want.

muc.title: State what happened
muc.text: Open with the facts: what you bought, when, the order number, what's wrong, with photos as evidence.

muc.title: Say what you want
muc.text: Then say clearly whether you want an exchange, a refund or a free repair, with a reasonable deadline.

muc.title: Tone the letter down
muc.text: Draft it while angry if you like, then ask a chatbot to remove the harsh words. Delete your phone number and address before pasting.

muc.title: A five-sentence letter
muc.text: Describe a faulty product and ask a chatbot for a five-sentence complaint with the facts and what you want.
